rationale: The pool contains multiple stability-focused patches (1.3.2 Patch 1 chunk 1825727806720496-2 explicitly states 'Made various game stability improvements'; 1.3.2 Notes chunk 1823191198616991-49 mentions 'improvements to late game performance and multiplayer stability'; 1.2.1 Patch 1 chunk 1800991756447780-2 resolved a crash; 1.3.0 Patch 1 chunk 1816215235354374-2 addresses an Age Transition crash).
